positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built the Infrastructure product that monitors millions of entities in real time
Scaled the Infrastructure platform which handles 99 million reqs/min
• Built and operated 41 high throughput Go microservices for the Infrastructure platform responsible for: edge ingest, alert evaluation, streaming data pipelines, indexing, downsampling, identity resolution, relationships, auth, public APIs
• Operated Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Kafka, ZooKeeper, and Mesos clusters in multiple regions
• On-call for all services and infrastructure, commanded incidents and lead retros
• Worked closely with support team and customers to troubleshoot the Infrastructure product

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built core service platform for microservices in AWS
• Implemented dynamic configuration delivery systems
• Designed and prototyped various experimental systems
    • Decentralized service discovery/configuration management
    • Time series data storage
    • Event/message journal engine

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Launched  War Commander, a high traffic web based MMO Real-Time Strategy game.
• Built a content pipeline to streamline development for the engineering/design teams.  
• Implemented dynamic world map with real-time conquest gameplay between thousands of players.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: • Developed a scalable SEO-ready CMS target at small to medium sized businesses.
